The italic *and* before *drinketh* answers to no waw — the Hebrew juxtaposes the clause with no conjunction in it — so it is `added` under rule 14's closing sentences rather than folded into the verb or a neighbouring preposition.
In *the rain of heaven* the rectum is rendered anarthrously, so the article morpheme on `הַשָּׁמַיִם` takes the fronted *the* and the construct `מְטַר` keeps only its noun (rule 29).
